description: Head-movement mini-game GA26, Wave 2 Group F (memory and rhythm advanced): six-direction memory game. Listen to a sequence over six directions (left, right, up, down, left tilt, right tilt) and reproduce it step by step, returning to center between steps. Rounds grow 3, then 4, then 5 steps. Three calibration prompts learn left, down and left-tilt signs. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: memory-six
